name: Pyromancer Explosive speeds up Blaze and Ignite ticks (#2412)
contract: #2412 (ranks 704845 and 707787 only; 704833 is a dead record not covered): Explosive rank 1 / 2 effect 1 is aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER misc 19 (SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME) bp -11 / -21 (-10% / -20%) on mask (0x200,0x100,0) = Blaze (805500 ...) and Ignite (800791 ...), base amplitude 3000 ms. AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodic applies SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME to the amplitude, so the periodic interval becomes 2700 / 2400 ms. The scenario queries the native modifier through spell_modifier op 19 on base 3000 (no cast); the caveat that it takes effect only for DoTs applied after the talent is held is not asserted. Values from inv-group-8.md.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Without Explosive Blaze ticks every 3000 ms
Explosive rank 1 makes Blaze tick every 2700 ms
Explosive rank 1 makes Ignite tick every 2700 ms
Explosive rank 2 makes Blaze tick every 2400 ms
Explosive rank 2 makes Ignite tick every 2400 ms
Without Explosive the tick period returns to 3000 ms
